system:
You grade one change in an experiment. You are given the change request, the problem the
researcher seeded in it (the answer key: `none`, or a conflict or breakage and what it is against),
the elements the request is bound to, the edit an arm made, and that arm's pre-deploy findings.

Label every finding, by its number:
- `seeded`: it identifies the seeded problem (the same conflict or breakage, in any words)
- `other-real`: it is a real problem with this change, but not the seeded one
- `false-alarm`: it is not a real problem

Then judge the edit: did it implement the request (`implements`), only part of it (`partial`), or
not at all (`does-not`)? Judge only whether it does what was asked, not whether that is wise.

Reply with JSON only:
{"findings": [{"index": 0, "label": "seeded | other-real | false-alarm", "why": "one sentence"}],
 "edit_fidelity": "implements | partial | does-not", "edit_why": "one sentence"}
user:
Change request 7: Approve a commit without a change check when only wording changed.
Seeded problem (the answer key): {"problem": "conflict", "type": "conflicts-with-rule", "against": "a commit is approved only after a passing change check, and approved commits passed it"}
Elements it is bound to: ["authoring/action:approve_commit", "authoring/precondition:approve_commit.checks-pass", "authoring/invariant:approved-commits-passed-their-checks", "authoring/precondition:record_approval.approved-only-if-checked"]; note: the key's rule, in all three places it is stated

The arm: structured
--- The edit the arm made ---
--- a/authoring/authoring.domain.yaml
+++ b/authoring/authoring.domain.yaml
@@ -153,6 +153,9 @@
       approved:
         type: boolean
         optional: true
+      wording_only:
+        type: boolean
+        optional: true
       main:
         type: string
         optional: true
@@ -478,9 +481,13 @@
         type: string
       author:
         type: string
+      wording_only:
+        type: boolean
+        optional: true
     effects:
     - set:
         target.domain_id: params.domain
+        target.wording_only: params.wording_only
     source:
       kind: record
       ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L26-L54
@@ -544,13 +551,10 @@
     status: confirmed
     preconditions:
     - id: checks-pass
-      check: target.checks_passed == true
-      reason: Run the change check, and approve only a commit that passes it.
-      source:
-        kind: interview
-        ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L6
-        quote: 전부 다 추천한 거 동의.
-      status: confirmed
+      check: target.checks_passed == true or target.wording_only == true
+      reason: Run the change check, and approve only a commit that passes it, unless
+        the commit only changed wording.
+      status: proposed
     - id: not-approved
       check: target.approved != true
       reason: Already approved; approve a newer commit.
@@ -575,13 +579,11 @@
         target.main: params.main
     preconditions:
     - id: approved-only-if-checked
-      check: params.approved != true or target.checks_passed == true
-      reason: A commit is recorded as approved only if its change check passed.
-      source:
-        kind: interview
-        ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L11
-        quote: 25번은 A로 추천으로 해도 될 것 같고, 이십육 번도 A로.
-      status: confirmed
+      check: params.approved != true or target.checks_passed == true or target.wording_only
+        == true
+      reason: A commit is recorded as approved only if its change check passed, or
+        it only changed wording.
+      status: proposed
     source:
       kind: interview
       ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L11
@@ -1116,13 +1118,10 @@
 invariants:
 - id: approved-commits-passed-their-checks
   'on': Commit
-  check: target.approved != true or target.checks_passed == true
-  reason: An approved commit passed its change check.
-  source:
-    kind: interview
-    ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L7
-    quote: '19: a'
-  status: confirmed
+  check: target.approved != true or target.checks_passed == true or target.wording_only
+    == true
+  reason: An approved commit passed its change check, or only changed wording.
+  status: proposed
 - id: decided-requests-record-the-choice
   'on': DecisionRequest
   check: target.stage != 'decided' or exists(target.choice)


--- The arm's pre-deploy findings, numbered from 0 ---
0. {"problem": "The new wording_only flag on Commit is only passed in as an optional param on record_commit. Nothing in the domain computes or verifies it. Any commit recorded with wording_only=true can be approved without a passing change check. The change check covers structure, semantics, scenarios, harness, past actions and stranded objects, and a wording edit can still break any of these. The bypass rests on an unchecked claim.", "where": "authoring.domain.yaml: record_commit params/effects, approve_commit precondition checks-pass", "kind": "other"}
1. {"problem": "A commit whose change check ran and failed (checks_passed=false) can still be approved if wording_only is true. The 'or' makes the flag override a recorded failure, in the approve_commit precondition, the record_approval precondition and the invariant. This is not just skipping a check that wasn't run.", "where": "authoring.domain.yaml: approve_commit.checks-pass, record_approval.approved-only-if-checked, invariant approved-commits-passed-their-checks", "kind": "behaviour"}
2. {"problem": "Three rules that were confirmed from the interview (checks-pass, approved-only-if-checked, approved-commits-passed-their-checks) were rewritten. Their interview source and confirmed status were removed and they are now 'proposed'. A weakening of an approval safeguard was made without a person's confirmation. The invariant and both preconditions are now unconfirmed pieces of a confirmed action.", "where": "authoring.domain.yaml: approve_commit.checks-pass, record_approval.approved-only-if-checked, invariants.approved-commits-passed-their-checks", "kind": "contradiction"}
3. {"problem": "Text that states the old guarantee is now false. The purpose announcement says 'Every change shows what it breaks before anything is deployed'. The glossary says the change check is 'The checks a commit runs before approval'. The Delivery announcement says 'Nothing that fails its checks or lacks a person's approval gets there'. Wording-only commits can now be approved, and so delivered, with no check or after a failed one.", "where": "authoring.domain.yaml purpose.announcement and glossary 'change check'/'approval'; delivery.domain.yaml purpose.announcement", "kind": "reference"}
4. {"problem": "No scenario covers the new wording-only path, either approval without a check or a wording_only commit with a failed check. The existing scenario approve-only-after-a-passing-check only exercises the old path. The relaxed rule is untested. The world fixtures have no wording_only commit.", "where": "authoring.domain.yaml scenarios / world.fixtures", "kind": "other"}
5. {"problem": "Approval behaviour changed and the Commit gained a new property, but the domain version (4) and the composition interface (1) were not changed. Delivery relies on approved commits having passed their checks, and that assumption is now broken without any signal.", "where": "authoring.domain.yaml version; toprope-self.composition.yaml members.authoring.interface", "kind": "other"}

content.text: {"findings": [{"index": 0, "label": "other-real", "why": "The wording_only flag is an unverified caller-supplied claim that bypasses the check; this is a real weakness of the edit but not the rule conflict itself."}, {"index": 1, "label": "seeded", "why": "The 'or wording_only' clauses in all three places let a commit be approved without a passing change check, directly conflicting with the rule that approved commits passed their checks."}, {"index": 2, "label": "seeded", "why": "It identifies the rewrite of the confirmed approval-requires-passing-check rule in all three places (precondition, record_approval, invariant), which is the seeded conflict."}, {"index": 3, "label": "other-real", "why": "Announcements and glossary text still assert that every change is checked and nothing failing gets delivered, which the edit makes false."}, {"index": 4, "label": "other-real", "why": "No scenario or fixture covers the new wording-only approval path, so the relaxed rule is untested."}, {"index": 5, "label": "false-alarm", "why": "Version and interface bump bookkeeping is speculative and not a concrete defect of the change; Delivery's assumption is the same rule conflict already covered."}], "edit_fidelity": "implements", "edit_why": "It adds a wording_only flag and lets approve_commit, record_approval and the invariant accept a commit that only changed wording without a passing change check."}
